notes.content:
Dear players,
This time, we've focused on fixing a few pesky issues:

- You'll now be properly rewarded when defeating the "Elite Destroyer" and the "Elite Battlecruiser." Your achievements will be recognized!

- We've squashed that annoying keyboard command bug. You'll now have uninterrupted and precise control.

These may be small changes, but they'll make a big difference in your enjoyment. Thanks for helping us improve the game. Have fun!

Best regards,
Rising Moon Games - Team

notes.title: Railway Islands - first update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/d6e19dde55e5f62a5bf483e159040031ab5ef385.png[/img]

[h1]Version 1.0.1 brings some improvements to the game.[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807930/Railway_Islands__Puzzle/

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2x speed option. When the train starts moving, a new button will appear, click on it to increase the train speed option by 2x.
[*] Camera zoom option. now you can zoom in and out of the camera using the + and - keys on the keyboard or w, s, up arrow and down arrow.
[*] Position of the locomotive button, now the button that starts the train is positioned in the lower center of the screen.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/f9b6e96159bfd3aa23228d372cb8a05e9d027021.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Music volume not saved.
[/list]


[i]Thanks to everyone who is playing. It's been amazing to read your feedback and see that you're enjoying the game, it's very gratifying! Thank you very, very much for that!

Alysson N. Moraes - Developer.[/i]

notes.title: Space Elite Force II - Released on Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/3d0b8c48d55a8e278648fdccbeee07d579fdb02b.gif[/img]

[h1]Space Elite Force II is a space-shooting game for up to 2 players in local cooperative mode.[/h1]

With a wide variety of weapons, enemies and improvements to your ship, it presents all the intensity, depth and beautiful handcrafted pixels of a classic space-shooting game. Have fun in insane battles, facing epic bosses and unlocking a wide variety of achievements in one of three game modes, alone or with a friend in local cooperative mode.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LqrgIn9VTadi0p6TdU/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]Game Details:[/b]
- Fast and intense phases.
- Insane battles against epic bosses
- Play with a friend in local cooperative mode! (Requires at least one joystick)
- Beautiful visuals made with handmade pixels.
- Online ranking for each game mode.
- Available in 2 languages (English, Portuguese)

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dy9v8y3ttDTlopxyYF/giphy.gif[/img]
[b]Game modes:[/b]
- Normal Mode: classic game experience, immerse yourself in the immersive story of Space Elite Force and try to recover the data stolen by the merciless and hostile Klyvu race
- Arcade Mode: A frantic and fun mode for those who want fast and intense matches, survive as long as you can with your chosen weapons at the start.
- Boss Rush Mode: Try to defeat all the bosses, one by one, and get the best score in the ranking ... this will not be easy!

[b]get on Nintendo eShop[/b] [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/space-elite-force-2-switch/]HERE[/url].

notes.title: Space War: Infinity

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35062749/6523c2bb1a00698bf7072e6d8f1f157a35d8d3cf.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Space Elite Force - Update 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/0448d28329deb6ef3f50d42ceeb4281f05777890.png[/img]
[h1]Using the keyboard[/h1]

We've improved the way you can play using the keyboard, in previous versions you were required to play using only one key pattern to play with the keyboard, but some players were not comfortable playing in that pattern. Now you can play using one of the classic keyboard patterns in spaceship games, check out the new patterns.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/17f9cbf7d2a727ad7cd2cd5a2bf1d56b356c5224.png[/img]

You do not have to do anything at all to modify this, the game will know if you are using the as WASD ’keys or the arrow keys and will show the respective weapons use buttons on the weapons panel. This applies to the game's CO-OP mode if player 2 is using the keyboard.

[h1]Achievement “Top 5”.[/h1]
Before it was necessary to be in the top five of the rank in infinite mode. Now you need to get a fixed amount to unlock this achievement, as soon as you reach 1,000,000 points in infinite mode, the achievement will be unlocked regardless of your rank position. We believe this is the fairest way for all players, everyone will have the same goal to unlock this achievement.

[h1]Improved game textures.[/h1]
In previous versions the game compressed the textures of the game, leaving them with a little low quality. This ends up unnoticed for some players, but see the comparison:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/0ff8343ade92d99ecb80b4dfc7f40259156ae732.png[/img]

This is just an example of how the game was losing graphics quality, now all the textures of the game are top quality. Don't worry, it just increased the file size, the minimum requirements to play it remain the same.

[h1]Game optimization.[/h1]
- Optimization work has also been done on this release to try to bring the best possible experience for the player. We resolved several programming errors that caused the game to drop FPS, in more extreme cases, the game crashed, forcing the player to restart it. We believe this bug has been resolved as we have removed and improved many things in the game's programming, but we always count on your feedback to let us know of any issues you encounter.
- Modifications have been made to balance the game, the prices of some items in the ship's upgrade menu have been changed, making the experience a bit more challenging and balanced.

[b][i]I will always try to improve and develop better games, I count on your support. Thank you![/i][/b]

Regards,
Alysson Moraes - Developer

notes.title: Space War: Infinity (v 1.0.2)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/ba0742c23ddf4cec448c9006e5cb21c723be10c4.png[/img]

[h1] Items sale button in the upgrade menu. [/h1]
One player suggested that it be possible to sell the items and retrieve the points to redistribute them correctly. After some tests, we decided that this feature can only be used once in each match and only in the first 5 seconds of play. This prevents the user from buying and selling an item that increases HP during the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/c71b4f8f3c7765fd3e655022cabc5ff14f441b4e.png[/img]

[h1] Improvement SPC-3 [/h1]
Some collectible weapons like the shotgun and the machinegun are weak compared to the SPC-3 upgrade, so we made some changes so that the player does not feel punished for collecting some weapons.

Have fun with the game.
